scope: ADR hygiene checker and regression harness moved from Python and shell into Rust under Buck2 authority
implementation_summary: Added scripts/ci/assert-adr-hygiene.rs with local/static ADR frontmatter parsing, duplicate-id checks, ADR-0377 renumbering checks, ADR-0511-to-ADR-0513 supersession checks, active-doc stale-reference checks, fixture validation, and compact JSON output.
Added scripts/tests/adr_hygiene_check.rs with checked-in pass coverage and adversarial red/green fixture mutations.
Updated BUCK, specs/adr-hygiene-registry.json, specs/red-green-fixture-contract.json, and specs/buck2-authority-policy.json so Buck2 remains the build/test/check authority for this gate.

checks.name: rust_test_compile
checks.evidence: test harness compiled with warnings denied

checks.name: adr_hygiene_json_contract
checks.command: OYA_REPO_ROOT=$PWD /tmp/assert-adr-hygiene --registry specs/adr-hygiene-registry.json --json > /tmp/adr-hygiene.json && jq -e '.verdict == "PASS" and .adr_hygiene_registry_published == true and .adr_hygiene_fixture_contract_measured == true and .fixture_count == 4 and .expected_green_fixture_count == 1 and .expected_red_fixture_count == 3 and .p0_0_green == false and .phase0_complete == false and .full_adr_index_regenerated == false and .failures == []' /tmp/adr-hygiene.json

checks.name: stale_retired_surface_sweep
checks.command: rg retired ADR hygiene Python/shell filenames and command invocations in BUCK specs scripts docs registry
checks.evidence: no active references to assert-adr-hygiene.py, adr_hygiene_check.test.sh, Python ADR checker invocation, shell ADR harness invocation, or ADR-specific PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE remain

focus: manual stale-reference matchers remain bounded to registry-declared patterns
fixture red/green mutations guard false positives and false negatives
no new dependency, Python, or shell test surface added

known_gaps: This is local/static gate evidence only; it does not regenerate the full ADR index.
This change does not mutate live branch protection, Kubernetes, cloud resources, secrets, or required-status producers.
GitHub Actions remains a temporary lane-unlocker, not permanent native CI/CD authority.
